checks.name: complete backend tests
checks.boundary: The eleven opt-in browser cases were run separately. Includes the new source, shared-budget and HTTP/API regressions; no real models.

checks.name: complete local browser chain
checks.boundary: Actual browser processes and local HTTP/API; synthetic pages and model protocol doubles. XHS page requests are intercepted, so these cases do not certify the live site.

checks.name: real Xiaohongshu module
checks.boundary: One live keyword and copied user session. Note bodies and signed URLs were not saved to the receipt. Publication times were unknown and remained null.

covered: Ten valid note bodies survive shared registration, then a web body is still readable.
Candidates are capped at ten for both sources, independently; no five-item merged truncation.
max_results supports integers one through ten and rejects out-of-range, boolean and fractional values.
Concurrent query result counters use distinct slots; per-request input exclusions and ledgers are isolated.
Shared twenty-call, five-query, fifteen-evidence budgets include failed operations and each note read.
Later crawler batches preserve one web read and one evidence slot; duplicates and stopped operations do not create evidence.
Original input IDs, equivalent link paths/default ports and final redirected web URLs are excluded.
Missing bodies, mismatched final identities, login walls and HTTP error documents are not evidence.
Partial evidence survives failures; webpage search and reading continue.
Lock waiting counts toward timeout; cancellation, page-creation failures, page-close failures and shutdown clean browser resources.
Actual action ledger remains authoritative for model references and returned evidence IDs.
Startup without a model key and separate login command remain available; GUI, Excel and offline JSONL runtime are absent.
limitations: The preserved local model api_key is empty. Full real-model verification and judgment quality are not accepted by these tests.
Ten is a collection upper target, not a credibility guarantee; source independence and authority still require cross-checking.
A single successful live query does not certify other keywords, future site structure, permanent login validity or resistance to rate limits.
Short input URLs without an identifiable note ID and text-only copies cannot be linked reliably to the same original post using URL identity alone.
Private rollback archives, browser profiles, database, local config, raw notes and runtime logs are excluded from Git.
push_policy: Only push the original-repository feature branch after local acceptance; preserve the commit and an external receipt if write permission is denied.
